knobs.name: Vertical Follow
knobs.description: How much the card follows your finger up and down. 0 keeps it level.

knobs.name: Tilt per Point
knobs.description: Degrees of tilt for each point the card moves sideways.

knobs.name: Grab Tilt
knobs.description: Grabbing the lower half tilts the card the other way, like a card held at the bottom.

knobs.name: Badge Fade Start
knobs.description: How far the card moves before the heart or ✕ starts to fade in.

knobs.name: Badge Fade End
knobs.description: Where the badge is fully shown. The same as Badge Fade Start makes it pop in.

knobs.name: Commit Pop
knobs.description: How much the badge grows once letting go would vote.

knobs.name: Commit Distance
knobs.description: How far the card has to be headed when you let go for it to count as a vote.

knobs.name: Throw Lookahead
knobs.description: Seconds of release speed added to the drag, so a quick flick counts. 0 judges by distance only.

knobs.name: Spring Response
knobs.description: How long the card takes to spring home or fly off.

knobs.name: Spring Damping
knobs.description: Below 1 the spring overshoots a little before it settles.

knobs.name: Card Flies Out
knobs.description: On: a vote throws the card off screen. Off, as in the shipped app: the card never leaves, and the next place springs back from your finger.

knobs.name: Fly-Out Distance
knobs.description: How far a thrown card flies.

knobs.name: Next Card Scale
knobs.description: The card underneath starts this small and grows as the top card nears Commit Distance. 1 shows no rise.

knobs.name: Button Nudge
knobs.description: Holding ✕ or ♥ nudges the top card that way.

knobs.name: Button Press Scale
knobs.description: How small ✕ and ♥ get while pressed.
